methodology: Contrast selected new Spanish localized actions with earlier Weiser working owner descriptions, manually differentiating same feast, general Corpus theatrical family, stage props, local variant and different actual religious rites. Labels and some original source passages inspected, but full older printed Weiser pages and witness independence not authenticated. No semantic equivalence or master promotions inferred.
